caller_contract_assessment: The old allowance rationale is not moot merely because five other non-English locales carry the namespace. Sidecar still requires English exception bytes. All 21 SDK guard sites in sdk.py/session/spec.py still explicitly use envelope(locale="en"), so adding fr/es text alone does not localize their existing raised exceptions. I independently rendered mode_invalid with explicit en and fr: the en result stays English and the fr result changes to French. Explicit-locale messages.render/envelope consumers and the eager wire catalogue can now expose localized text rather than English fallback; wire_namespaces(fr) includes this namespace and it is not deferred, so catalogue content/cache identity changes too. Publishing translations is not a caller-contract migration.
